moments.author: Stephen Curry
moments.quote: Curry drills eight threes and leads Warriors to historic 25‑point comeback over Lakers in NBA Cup opener
moments.why: A rare, all‑time era comeback that men 25‑45 can’t stop talking about—Curry shreds Luka and flips a 25‑point hole into a statement win.

moments.author: JJ Redick
moments.quote: Team needs patience—also, yes I got hemorrhoid cream courtside
moments.why: Redick’s off‑comment about courtside hemorrhoid cream turned into a meme‑fueling moment among guys online.

moments.author: Warriors bench (collective chatter)
moments.quote: Bench eruption turns 25‑point deficit into win
moments.why: The Warriors’ bench—not stars—drove the turnaround, spotlighting role‑player heroics that resonate with team‑first culture.

moments.author: NBA on ESPN
moments.quote: Steph passes Dominique Wilkins, moves into 18th on NBA’s all‑time scoring list during comeback
moments.why: Milestone scoring achievement paired with a crazy comeback amplified its buzz among sports guys.
